findings.title: Migration crashes when embed_category is unset
findings.body: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration does execute("SELECT c.id ... WHERE s.name='embed_category'")[0]['id']. If the site never set embed_category (default blank) or has no matching category, [0] is nil and calling ['id'] raises NoMethodError, aborting the migration for fresh installs and most existing sites.

findings.title: Migration SQL injection and unnormalized hosts
findings.body: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration interpolates each raw site-setting value directly into SQL: "INSERT ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)". A host containing a single quote breaks the statement or injects SQL. It also bypasses EmbeddableHost normalization, so values like 'http://example.com/1234' are stored verbatim while runtime lookup compares only bare hostname, leaving migrated hosts non-matching.

findings.title: before_validation crashes on nil host
findings.body: In app/models/embeddable_host.rb the before_validation block calls self.host.sub! twice without checking presence. Creating an EmbeddableHost with nil/missing host raises NoMethodError instead of a validation error, turning a user error into a 500.

findings.title: update/destroy dereference missing record
findings.body: In app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb update and destroy do EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first and then immediately call save_host(host)/host.destroy. For an unknown id host is nil, causing NoMethodError (500) instead of a 404. save_host also assumes params[:embeddable_host] is present.

findings.title: No uniqueness constraint on host
findings.body: In app/models/embeddable_host.rb there is only a format validation and in the migration there is no unique index on embeddable_hosts.host. Duplicate hosts (including case variants, since lookup is lower(host)=?) can be created, allowing ambiguous category mapping and duplicate admin rows.

findings.title: Plural embedded ids assumed to be array
findings.body: In app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/store.js.es6 _hydrateEmbedded now calls obj[k].map for any key ending in _ids. If the payload has null, undefined, or a single value for such a key, .map throws TypeError and breaks hydration of the whole record (e.g. embedding). It also stores undefined entries for ids with no match instead of compacting.
